output.reason: The 3.0.0 changelog lists this as an internal Argo CD server change: informer objects are now deep-copied [ev-f9d32317b49c]. The PR changes only server code (application.go, deepinformer.go) and adds no setting, flag or values key [ev-28eb892e1e02], so the only exposure is upgrading the server across this release. The linked issue describes server crashes since 2.14 [ev-faa4a8aadfad, ev-2c224906fce2]. The proposal uses product-version for Argo CD's own version, but product-version is for other products, and '>=3.0.0 in-range' reads the version an environment already runs, so it misses environments upgrading from 2.x; the right predicate is the upgrade from-version below 3.0.0 (whether the fix was backported to 2.x releases is not stated).

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0's API server makes deep copies of objects returned by informers, so they are not shared. This applies to every environment upgrading from a version below 3.0.0. No configuration controls it.
